audience: online shop owners who run one MerchantPro shop

useCases.title: Check orders waiting for shipment
useCases.text: List orders filtered by shipping or payment status. Open one order to read its line items, totals and addresses.

useCases.title: Find products low on stock
useCases.text: List products, filtered by SKU, EAN, category or tag. Open one product to read its stock and prices.

useCases.title: Set the stock of one product
useCases.text: Give the SKU, EAN or id of one product and set its stock to an exact value. The live shop shows the new stock at once.

useCases.title: Change the status of an order
useCases.text: Set an order to in_process, shipped, delivered, returned or cancelled. The customer may get an email. Cancelling or returning can refund or reverse stock.
